meta.title: fix: enhance API Keys component with loading indicators and performance optimizations
meta.body_summary: Enhance API Keys component with loading states, a 10s query timeout with abort/retry, an LRU cache (max 1000 entries), and centralized error handling.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added loading states, LRU cache, and 10s timeout; closed by maintainer riderx after ~3.6h with no review or merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 870 changed lines across 7 files, this is a medium-sized frontend enhancement by absolute volume. It fits a moderate incremental performance PR that was closed without merge, likely due to lack of maintainer review engagement.

review_details.performance_claim: Improved user experience with loading indicators, reduced query duration via 10s timeout, and bounded memory via LRU cache (max 1000 entries).
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by riderx 3.6 hours after creation with no review comments or merge; rejection reason unknown.

core_change_summary.description: Enhanced ApiKeys.vue with loading indicators, timeout mechanism (AbortController, 10s limit, retry with backoff), and replaced simple Map cache with an LRU cache (max 1000 entries). Added utility files for caching (cacheUtils.ts), error handling (errorUtils.ts), and Supabase utils (supabaseUtils.ts) for timeout/retry logic.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commit brought in changelog, version bump, and unrelated UsageCard changes.
